lines.en: I hop along, my body wobbling.
A hop, a flatten, another hop.

lines.zh: 我的身体里有小气泡在冒
lines.en: Little bubbles rise inside me.

lines.zh: 我跳过沙滩，留下一摊湿印
lines.en: I hop across sand, leaving wet marks.
I shift along, not quickly.

lines.zh: 草叶穿过我，我也不在意
lines.en: Grass passes through me; I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我蹦起来，落地时弹了一下
lines.en: I bounce up and rebound on landing.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在阳光下很亮
lines.en: My color is bright in the sun.
I hop toward the water; it's cool there.

lines.zh: 每一步都在地上按出印子
lines.en: Each step presses a print into the ground.
I jump high, but slowly.

lines.zh: 水草挡路，我直接穿过去
lines.en: Water weeds block me; I just pass through.

lines.zh: 我一边跳一边发出声音
lines.en: I make a sound with every hop.
I jiggle like jelly.

lines.zh: 我跟在同伴后面，慢慢跳
lines.en: I follow my fellows, hopping slowly.

lines.zh: 我跳到石头上，滑了下来
lines.en: I hop onto a stone and slide off.
I flatten out like a little pool.
I wobble; a bubble floats up.
I swell quietly, then slowly shrink.
Sunlight makes my body shine.
I hear the sound of waves.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，很难被发现
lines.en: When I'm still, I'm hard to spot.
A small bug settles on me.
I don't shoo it, and it isn't afraid.

lines.zh: 我一半浸在水里，很舒服
lines.en: Half in the water — feels good.
I press softly against the ground.

lines.zh: 我内侧有一点光在流转
lines.en: A little light moves inside me.

lines.zh: 我想着要不要再跳一下
lines.en: I wonder whether to hop again.
You look down at me with big eyes.
I bounce once, as an answer.
You can't step on me. I'm slippery.
I wobble, waiting for you to move.

lines.zh: 你影子落在我身上，凉了
lines.en: Your shadow falls on me; it's cool.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，虽然我没有头
lines.en: I look up, though I've no head.

lines.zh: 你要摸我吗，会沾一手水
lines.en: Touch me? You'll get a wet hand.
I've come a little closer.

lines.zh: 你的靴子比我整个人都硬
lines.en: Your boot is harder than all of me.
I'm not afraid. Only curious.
A bit of me is knocked loose.
I wobble a long time before steadying.

lines.zh: 身体里有一部分变淡了
lines.en: Part of me has gone pale.
I retreat, leaving a wet trail.
That passed through me. Unpleasant.
I bounce up, then down.
I'm a size smaller.
Something inside me aches.
I shrink into a blob and keep still.
One more and I'll come apart.
What's that? Bright color.
I shift toward it, slowly.
I've no mouth, but I want it.
Put it on the ground.
I touch it; it's cool.
I don't quite understand this smell.
I fold it into my body.

lines.zh: 再给我一点，我还没吃够。
lines.en: Give me more; I am not full yet.
I bounce a little, pleased.
Too hard; I can't wrap around it.
You stepped on me; I slid away.
I'm pressed to your leg, cool.
One bump and I flatten.
I bounce back into shape.
Don't push; I'll spread out.
I flow past your feet.
A wet patch is left behind.
Hit a stone and I bounce high.
The two of us are squashed together.
I shift away slowly. No hurry.
Your feet are warmer than I expected.

lines.zh: 被撞了，我晃了好一会儿
lines.en: After the bump, I wobble a long while.
I've stuck to your sole.

lines.zh: 这一下把我推出去一远
lines.en: That shoved me a good distance.
Are you tropical too?
Our colors don't match.
Two of us hop together, in rhythm.
I touch you, and you touch back.
The water's nicer. Come along.
I hop slowly; wait for me.
Between us there's no boundary.
This pool is ours together.
Too much sun; let's go under the trees.

lines.zh: 跳得慢一点，路上有石头
lines.en: Hop slower — there are stones here.
I've wrapped around it.
It floats inside me.
I move slowly, afraid it'll drop out.
Too heavy for me to lift.
I push it along with my body.
I can take in anything on the ground.
It's changing color inside me.
I push it back out.
I don't really want this one.
I draw it in bit by bit.
Something moved; I stop.
I turn my body that way.
The grass sways — wind.
A shadow falls beside me.
I bounce once, on alert.
I'm not much of a chaser.
That thing is much bigger than me.
I retreat half a step into the water.
The water's murmur is faint; I can tell.
It hasn't seen me.

lines.zh: 我半透明地滑过沙地，靠近你。
lines.en: I slide translucent across the sand toward you.
I approach slowly, making no sound.
Its back is to the water.
One hop brings me a step closer.
It turns; I freeze.
The ground is slick — suits me.
I count its steps.
It's some way from the water's edge.
A bit closer is all I need.

lines.zh: 我准备好了，随时弹过去
lines.en: I'm ready to spring at any moment.
I lunge and cling to it whole.
My body sticks to its leg.
It moves; I wobble along with it.
No teeth — this is all I can do.
It steps into my body.
I wrap it up and slowly tighten.
It can't shake me off.
I'm cool, and it doesn't like it.
I bounce off and land back in the water.
That's enough already.
I take shape slowly by the water.
At first I'm a small blob.
I swell, then sag.

lines.zh: 第一下跳动，我撞到了草
lines.en: My first hop knocks into grass.
The damp air suits me.
A wet patch appears on the sand.
I hear water, far away.

lines.zh: 我还没学会控制这身体
lines.en: I haven't learned to control this body.
The damp air suits me.
This beach is warm.
The heat shrinks me.

lines.zh: 从高处落下，我摔成一摊
lines.en: I fall from a height and splatter.

lines.zh: 水太多，我反而混进去了
lines.en: Too much water — I begin to dissolve into it.
The blast tears my body apart.
Something passes through, leaving a hole.
A force thickens me.
I grow smaller and fainter.
Lightning strikes; I shudder hard.
I fall, and my body scatters.
